findings.description: `Kanban` declares `ralphState: OverviewRalphState` as a required prop in its type signature (tools/overview-viewer/src/components/Kanban.tsx:97) but does not destructure or consume it inside the function body. App.tsx and the kanban tests pass `ralphState={ralphState}` / `ralphState={NO_RALPH_STATE}` solely to satisfy TypeScript. The plan deliberately reserves the slot for downstream Plan 04, but in the current ship state it is a required-but-unused prop, which is a quality footgun: a future renamed destructure or accidental positional drop would silently typecheck. Either destructure `ralphState` and drop it with an inline comment so the linter knows it is intentional, or relax the prop to optional (`ralphState?: OverviewRalphState`) until Plan 04 actually wires it.
findings.resolution: Destructured ralphState as _ralphState in Kanban function argument list (Kanban.tsx:97). Required prop preserved for Plan 04. Typecheck + 7 kanban tests green. Round-2 re-review verified: commit de232734 lands the destructure cleanly, 119 vitest tests pass.
findings.suggestedFix: Destructure `ralphState` in the function arg list and prefix with `_` (e.g., `{ data, _ralphState, onJumpToCommand, visibleTaskIds }`), or relax the type to `ralphState?: OverviewRalphState` until Plan 04 consumes it. Either makes the unused-but-required contract explicit.

findings.description: `RalphStageChip` wraps every chip in its own `<Tooltip.Provider delayDuration={200} skipDelayDuration={0}>` (tools/overview-viewer/src/components/RalphStageChip.tsx:20). Because the chip is rendered once per task row in `CommandList`, this creates one Tooltip.Provider per row. `WorkstreamPill` already does the same, so this is consistent with the existing pattern, but a single top-level `<Tooltip.Provider>` around the whole app (or per-list) would be lighter and matches Radix's recommendation. Not a bug; quality nit only.
findings.resolution: Hoisting Tooltip.Provider to App.tsx would break interaction tests that render RalphStageChip and WorkstreamPill in isolation without an App wrapper. Cross-cutting test changes also conflict with CLAUDE.md parallel-work guardrail. Per-component provider is functionally correct; optimization deferred.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer to a follow-up: hoist `<Tooltip.Provider>` to App.tsx or CommandList and drop the per-chip wrapper from both RalphStageChip and WorkstreamPill in the same pass. Not in scope for Plan 03.

findings.description: `NO_RALPH_STAGE = '__no_ralph__'` in tools/overview-viewer/src/utils/filters.ts:5 is a magic-string sentinel used inside `matchesTaskFilter` / `matchesKanbanFilter` to denote untracked tasks. The reserved value is invisible to readers of `RalphStage` and a future stage literal named `__no_ralph__` (vanishingly unlikely, but possible if the union ever opens) would collide. Optional hardening: rename to `RALPH_STAGE_NONE` or annotate the union/type docs so the reserved string is discoverable.
findings.resolution: Added 1-line JSDoc comment above NO_RALPH_STAGE in filters.ts explaining the sentinel is intentionally outside the RalphStage union. Typecheck + 119 tests green. Round-2 re-review verified: commit 24c173dd lands the JSDoc cleanly.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a one-line jsdoc to `RalphStage` in types.ts noting `__no_ralph__` is reserved by filters.ts, or move the sentinel into types.ts so the reservation lives next to the union.
